A post is added when it states a new or changed directional stance on one asset in Bob's own voice (a position, or a clear expectation with a direction), with the asset and side chosen by hand. Skipped: conditionals ('if X then'), descriptions of the past, posts that are bullish and bearish at once, quoted text that is not his view, and repeats of a stance already added for the same asset and side within 14 days (so one opinion is not counted several times). Every decision has a reason.
